references.text: Both verses concern bringing a case to the city elders at the city gate for legal proceedings
The city gate as the place where the elders sit to judge in legal cases
The elders at the city gate serve as judges and witnesses in legal matters
The city gate is mentioned as the place where the elders gather to administer justice
The elders at the city gate who exercise justice and judgment
The elders in the city have authority to arrest and deliver persons for judgment
Prohibition against striking parents, illustrating parental authority to bring children to judgment
